metadata.name: sftp.tokens
metadata.description: Top-level index of the SFTP design-token set. OpenDesign token model: global tier (scales) + semantic tier (roles) per theme. Single source of truth for web (web/src/theme/opendesign) and mobile (mobile/shared .../theme) derived packs.
metadata.assumption: The open_design submodule (nexu-io/open-design) was not present in the checkout when these tokens were authored (added in parallel by another stream). The token model therefore follows the canonical OpenDesign structure — design tokens as JSON with color/typography/spacing/radius/elevation scales and semantic + component tiers — and MUST be reconciled against the submodule's schema once it lands.

component_tier.note: Component-level tokens (button/input/table binding of semantic roles) are authored by the web + mobile streams as components land; this file reserves the tier.
